chunks: And Abū al-Ḥasan Mūsā ibn Jaʿfar عليهما السلام said:
"Rajab is a river in Paradise, whiter than milk and sweeter than honey. So whoever fasts one day of Rajab, Allah will give him drink from that river."

key_terms.اللَّهُ: Allah, the One who bestows the reward
key_terms.الْجَنَّةِ: Paradise, the place where this river is found
key_terms.رَجَبٌ: Rajab, the sacred month being described and encouraged for fasting
key_terms.سَقَاهُ: gave him to drink, referring to Allah granting the reward
key_terms.نَهَرٌ: a river, used here for the heavenly reality associated with Rajab

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for fasting one day in Rajab?
ai.summary: This hadith describes Rajab through the image of a river in Paradise of extraordinary purity and sweetness. It encourages fasting in the month of Rajab by promising a heavenly reward from Allah for even one day of sawm.
